citation.authors: David E, Shokrian N, Del Duca E, Meariman M et al
citation.journal: Journal of the American Academy of Dermatology

cited_by.title: CCCA: scarring hair loss at the crown

record.population: Adults with lichen planopilaris, frontal fibrosing alopecia or central centrifugal cicatricial alopecia (how many had CCCA is not stated in the abstract)
record.design: Randomised, placebo-controlled phase 2a trial, 3:1 to brepocitinib 45 mg daily or placebo for 24 weeks, then all on drug to 48 weeks
record.finding: Brepocitinib significantly lowered lesional CCL5 expression at week 24 (P=.004), was well tolerated and improved clinical severity scores. Coprimary endpoints were biomarkers and safety, not hair regrowth. The authors list a single dose and a small placebo group as limitations.
record.note: Mixed scarring alopecias, an experimental drug, biomarker endpoints; not evidence about what to do for CCCA today. Added after the 12 Nov fact-check search.
